namespace_struct.parser: requires 'namespaces' property from the ans node to be OSData with length divisible by 12; count = length/12 (magic-divide constant 0xAAAAAAAB at 0x9c7ab24); stores count at buf[0] and copies raw bytes after +4 (field [x20,#0x7e0])

record_layout.use: namespace type; log 'NSID %d NSType %d NSSize %u' at 0x9c7e8d4 (cc5) / 0x9c7e8f0 (cd8)
logged as NSSize ('%s::%d:NSSize\t\t: %u' 0x8cdcec); ALSO the expected NSZE comparison value in ValidateNamespaceSize (ldr w8,[x9] where x9 = fNamespaces+4+nsid*12: i.e. record[nsid-1].word2)

namespace_struct.word2_note: word2 doubles as the DT-declared size used in the NSZE cross-check; for NSID1 (word2=0) the alternate size path uses [x19,#0x4b8] ('Burn-in blks set. NSID1 now sized to %lld' 0x8cdc61) or the caller-supplied capacity (inByteCapacity, 0x8cdc93); exact units for word2 are LBAs per the Identify comparison semantics (compared directly against Identify NSZE which is in LBAs)

functions.role: read DT namespaces into fNamespaces struct ([x20,#0x7e0])
identifies nsid[n] as nstype[n]; 'Identified nsid[%d] as nstype[%d]' (0x8cdb03)
allocates per-NS structs, calls ValidateNamespaceSize, publishes block devices; 'Creating %d namespaces on NAND' (0x8cdd01); per-NS logging NSID/NSType/NSSize

Identify Namespace (opcode 0x11, 0x1000-byte buffer), parses FLBAS (byte 0x1a) and LBAF entry (offset 0x80 + 4*flbas), checks METADATA_SIZE==0, then asserts logicalBlockSize==4096 (0x8cde5b) or logs 'Invalid LogicalBlockSize=%d' (0x8cdde8); compares Identify NSZE (offset 8) against fNamespaces record word2

identify_path.identify_namespace: opcode 0x11 issued in ValidateNamespaceSize (mov w0,#0x11 before 0xfffffff009cd711c command-issue at 0x9c7b3cc; buffer 0x1000)

fields.name: NSZE
fields.use: compared against DT-declared word2 for the NSID

fields.name: NLBAF
fields.use: num LBA formats; FLBAS must be < NLBAF+1 (b.hs reject at 0x9c7ebe4)

fields.name: LBAF table
fields.use: exact current-build checks: (1) u16 at entry+0 must be ZERO (ldrh w8,[x9] + cbnz -> fail at 0x9c7ed54); (2) u8 at entry+2 must equal 12 (ldrb w8,[x9,#2] + cmp w8,#0xc at 0x9c7ebfc); (3) logicalBlockSize = 1 << entry+2 = 4096; on mismatch logs 'Invalid LogicalBlockSize = %d' with 1<<entry2 and asserts '( logicalBlockSize == 4096 )' (0x8cde5b)

identify_path.derivation: LBA size comes from the Identify Namespace LBAF entry selected by FLBAS: entry+0 u16 must be zero and entry+2 u8 is the size exponent; the driver computes logicalBlockSize = 1 << entry+2, logs/asserts it must equal 4096 (exponent 12). It is NOT taken from the DT, not from APFS, and not a standalone hardcoded constant.
identify_path.lba_size_4096_evidence: assert string '( logicalBlockSize == 4096 )' at 0xfffffff0078cde5b used from ValidateNamespaceSize fail path; 'Invalid LogicalBlockSize = %d' 0x8cdde8; LBADS must be 12 (cmp w8,#0xc at 0x9c7ebfc) -> 1<<12 = 4096; range assert 'LBADataSize >= kNVME_512_LBA_Data && LBADataSize <= kNVME_Max_LBA_Data' (0x8d4e0b) with 512_LBA constant string '512' (0x8d2552)

lba_proof.proof_chain: Identify Namespace -> LBAF[FLBAS].LBADS must equal 12 (cmp w8,#0xc) -> 1<<12 = 4096; failure asserts 'logicalBlockSize == 4096'
lba_proof.capacity_unit: LBA (logical block addresses); NSZE is compared directly against DT word2 without scaling, and NSZE is defined in LBAs; block counts are 'numBlocks' (Identified numBlocks %d Expected numBlocks %d)
lba_proof.overflow_safe: count derived as length/12 via magic-multiply (umull + lsr #35) on u32 length; no shift overflow path found

namespace_map.publication_evidence: CreateNamespaces loop publishes one IOBlockStorageDevice per NSID via attach (AppleEmbeddedBlockDevice alloc at 0x9c86820 / 0x9c86d44; size 0x100; attach via vtab+0x88 at 0x9c7e758); media properties 'Logical Block Size' (0x8db09c) and 'Physical Block Size' (0x8db088) set on the device
